item.title: Essential Parenting Supports-Parenting Skills Training Prog
item.description:
Administration for Children's Services | Procurement | Award | $1.2M | Vendor: Young Adult Institute Inc. In plain English (machine-written): The Administration for Children's Services awarded Young Adult Institute Inc. a $1,198,935 contract, chosen from competitive proposals of pre-qualified vendors, to provide parenting skills training, one-on-one coaching and linkages to services for parents with suspected or documented intellectual or developmental disabilities.

Tailored specifically for parents/caregivers with a suspected or documented I/DD or cognitive delay that may impact their ability to safely parent. The ACS Developmental Disabilities Unit (DDU) partners with New York State Office for People with Developmental Disabilities (OPWDD) providers to offer parenting skills training, one-on-one coaching, and linkages to supports and services for parents with a suspicion of and/or documented I/DD, including those with dual diagnoses of I/DD and other clinical needs.  Essential Parenting Supports connects ACS-involved parents living with suspected or documented I/DD with parenting supports in a flexible, individualized manner that builds on parents strengths and engages them in their own development. This contract includes an unallocated budget line for the allowance funding initiative.

item.title: Music and Performing Arts for Youth in Detention
item.description:
Administration for Children's Services | Procurement | Award | $292K | Vendor: The Carnegie Hall Corporation In plain English (machine-written): The Administration for Children's Services awarded The Carnegie Hall Corporation a $291,651 negotiated contract to continue music and performing arts programs for youth in detention from Nov. 1, 2026, through June 30, 2027, while the agency finishes seeking bids for a new contract.

Pursuant to Section 3-04 (b)(2)(iii) of the Procurement Policy Board Rules. The Administration for Children's Services intends to extend the Music and Performances Art contract for seven months through the negotiated acquisition extension procurement method from November 1, 2026 through June 30, 2027, to continue providing this mandated service while ACS completes the RFP process for a new award. The RFP is anticipated to be released around the second quarter of 2026, with new a contract to begin on July 1, 2027.
